about_the_game:
"Xeno Swarm" is a hardcore retro side-scrolling shooter with a classic pixel art style. Players can choose between male and female protagonists to battle overwhelming hordes of alien creatures. The game focuses on swarms of insects and epic boss fights, blending modern smooth controls with nostalgic arcade gameplay. Engage in life-or-death battles on an oppressive alien battlefield, fighting for humanity's last hope!

Game Features:

  • 90s retro CRT arcade style

  • Multiple primary weapon systems, sub-weapon systems, and energy weapon systems

  • Frenzied insect swarms and gigantic bosses

P.S. Currently, only screenshots of the male protagonist in the first level are available. Videos and new level screenshots will be updated later, and a demo version will also be provided. Please add it to your wishlist! :D
